_meta.comment:
Source-of-truth English strings. Every translatable string the templates render is keyed here. Site constants (legal name, address, business IDs) stay in src/_data/site.json and are interpolated by templates. HTML entities (®, ·,  ) and tags (
) stay in values verbatim — they are markup the translator may relocate but not strip. The t filter throws on missing keys (drift alarm).
